name: foilspf
note: 10D all-foils stopping target: three Lagrange-quadratic profiles (rOut, halfThickness, hole fraction) across 49 foils plus a stack-length knob, vs the foilsflash sob+flash objective. Replaces the deployed 37-foil base entirely -- there is no pinned baseline. Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-27-foilspf-profile-stopping-target-design.md EXTENT is 400-1100, the original design range. It was briefly capped to 400-800 on 2026-07-28 because Offline placed the proton absorber RELATIVE to the target's downstream end, so a longer stack dragged the absorber (and its support wires) out of DS2Vacuum. That headroom problem, not the cap, was the real constraint: the absorber is now held at its own absolute position (protonabsorber.zStartInMu2e=6901.02, with the distFromTargetEnd expression kept as an exact fail-safe for a stale/unpatched lib -- docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-31-ipa-absolute-position-design.md), which is what reopened the full 400-1100 range.

lines.comment: === foilspf (10D profile mode) === {n_foils} free foils, no pinned base
rOut  profile: {rOut_0:.2f} -> {rOut_1:.2f} -> {rOut_2:.2f} mm (Lagrange quadratic, u = i/48)
extent {extent:.1f} mm over 48 gaps -> deltaZ {deltaZ:.6f} mm; centre pinned at z0 {z0:.1f}

EXTENT CEILING 1100 -> 1700, measured 2026-08-02 after foilspf02 PINNED 1100 (its two best new Pareto points both sat exactly on the bound). The stack is CENTRE-pinned at z0=5871 and grows symmetrically, so the walls are upstream 2*(5871-5000)=1742 (EMC_Source, relocated) and downstream 2*(6901.02-5871)=2060 (IPA, absolutely pinned) -- upstream binds. Live preflight at the WORST corner (rOut 120/120/120, hT .15/.15/.15, solid f=0 -> maximal material, so a PASS certifies the whole box at that extent): 1100 PASS 0 overlaps, 1400 PASS 0, 1700 PASS 0, 1800 FAIL (VirtualDetector_EMC_Source vs StoppingTargetMother by 3.401 cm -- upstream edge 4971 is 29mm past the VD, and the reported 34mm depth matches). 1700 keeps 42mm of margin below the 1742 wall, the same margin convention the old 1100/1142 pair used.

protonabsorber.distFromTargetEnd {ipa_dist:.3f} (stock 625). Offline places the IPA at targetEnd+distFromTargetEnd -- i.e. RELATIVE to the stopping target -- but the IPA is fixed hardware at z=6901-7901. Without this compensation a longer target slides the absorber the same distance downstream as a RIGID body (length is unchanged: pabs1halflen saturates at the protonabsorber.halfLength=500 cap), which both mis-simulates real in-beam material and pushes its support wires out of DS2Vacuum. This holds the absorber at its true absolute position for any extent; at extent 800 it returns the stock 625 exactly. Measured with protonabsorber.verbosityLevel=1: 6901.02-7901.02 at extent 400, 800 and 1100, identical to stock.

EMC_Source relocated 5300 -> 5000. It is a 20um disc of ds.vacuumMaterial (vd.halfLength=0.01) -- ZERO mass, no scattering, no absorption -- and NO foils-family stage reads virtual detectors (only pot_only instantiates ReadVirtualDetector). At 5300 it was the UPSTREAM wall of the zero-overlap corridor, capping the stack at 6271-5300=971mm. zEMCSourceInMu2e is a plain c.getDouble default at VirtualDetectorMaker.cc:189, so this is one config line, no source patch. EMC_Source2 stays at 4800, so ordering is preserved.

protonabsorber.zStartInMu2e 6901.02: ABSOLUTE pin, authoritative under the patched GeometryService (maker substitutes targetEnd = zStartInMu2e - distFromTargetEnd, so placement is 6901.02 exactly; see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-31-ipa-absolute-position-design.md). The distFromTargetEnd expression above STAYS as the fail-safe: an unpatched lib ignores this key and the expression alone still places the absorber at 6901.02 (cylindrical IPA, OutRadius0 == OutRadius1 == 300.5, so the two routes are degenerate). Consistency pinned by tests/test_foilspf_spec.py.
POISON PILL: an unpatched StoppingTargetMaker ignores holeRadii and reads
this scalar. 1e6 forces a loud G4Tubs crash instead of a silently uniform
stack -- emitting a 'sensible' scalar is how 62 foilsg rows were lost.
Degrader parked at 120 deg (mmackenz hardware detent)

TT_MidInner -> DS2Vacuum workaround REMOVED 2026-07-28 (Run1Bap migration) -- see mode_specs/foilsflash.json for the full mechanism. Short version: v13_12_10 parented tracker VDs on `isDumbbell` so they landed in DS2Vacuum while the tracker sat in DS3Vacuum (GeomMgt0002 fatal); the override forced agreement. v13_32_10 keys VD parenting on !tracker.inDS2Vacuum, making stock self-consistent -- and keeping the override is what held the last EMC_0_Front overlap.
